name: Corte Suprema de Justicia
notes: Supreme Court of Justice of Paraguay.

name: Cámara de Senadores
notes: 45 seats, one nationwide constituency. Who sits and their party or movement are from the Senate's own list of senators by party and movement. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Cámara de Diputados
notes: 80 seats elected by department. Who sits is the Chamber's own alphabetical list, which gives each deputy a party or alliance code: codes of the departmental alliances of the 2023 election (CN2023, APUNP, APUNG, ATJPÑ, AC, APAD) are grouped as Concertación. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
